source: hand-authored fixture for issue #469 — not shipped data
description: Issue #469: a proposed drug carrying an interaction rule rated in a word this module does not recognise ('Serious', as in drug-reference-unrecognised-severity.json) and one rated Major, against two of patient 7's orders (aspirin order 111 and AnswerFromFindingsWarfarinOrderTestData.xml). DrugSafetyValidator.severityRank answers -1 for the word, so the rule withholds and FINDING_STRENGTH_DESCENDING orders it ahead of Major, as it does an unrated one; but it carries a rating, so only a key asking whether the rating is a reason to withhold, and not whether there is one, puts the Major rule under the 'No'. Aspirin and Warfarin carry no rule and exist only so her orders resolve.

interactions.note: Concurrent use may reduce the antiplatelet effect of aspirin.
Coadministration may increase the risk of bleeding.
